limits.en: 50 credits/day, no song downloads, no commercial rights, shared creation queue, v6-mini model only.

keyLimits.en: 50 credits/day, no song downloads, no commercial rights, shared creation queue, v6-mini model only.
2,500 credits/month, 20 song downloads/month, commercial rights included, priority queue, up to 10 songs at once, 30 min audio upload, 2 stem separation types.
10,000 credits/month, 60 song downloads/month, access to Suno Studio (MIDI, effects, automation), 3 stem separation types, custom models.

cautions.en: Credits do not carry over from day to day or month to month.

capabilities.en: Generates complete songs (lyrics, vocals, instrumentation) from a text description in under a minute.
Multiple AI model versions (v6, v6-mini, v6-wild) with different quality/speed tradeoffs.
Stem separation to isolate vocals/instruments, with more stem types on higher tiers.
Suno Studio (Premier tier) adds MIDI export, effects and automation for deeper editing.

limitations.en: Free plan has no commercial rights and no song downloads, limiting it to experimentation.
Custom model training is restricted to paid (Pro/Premier) plans.
Credits are monthly allotments that expire unused, so irregular usage wastes quota.

reason.en: Direct competitor generating full AI songs from text prompts with similar commercial licensing tiers.
Overlaps for AI-generated audio and voice, used by some creators alongside Suno for production.

unknowns: Whether a native mobile app exists was not confirmed on the pricing page.
